summary: Grist is a self-hosted relational spreadsheet/database server. The home metadata database (app/gen-server: TypeORM entities + HomeDBManager) persists the site model -- users, logins, orgs/workspaces/docs, groups + ACL rules, shares, config, billing/limits, proposals, service accounts, oauth clients -- exposed via /api REST; the per-document database (app/server/lib DocApi + ActiveDoc + DocStorage) persists each document's tables/columns/records via a user-action apply pipeline. Both halves have read+write operations, so CRUD was mined.
